verdict_policy: predeclared: improves only if every nominal 60d allocation family gains >2pp PASS and lowers MLL; degrades if any loses >2pp PASS or adds >2pp MLL; otherwise neutral

rules.mll_monitoring: intraday one-minute conservative adverse OHLC mark; floor updates EOD and locks at starting balance

stress_definitions.cost_2ticks: one additional adverse tick per filled side for every sleeve
stress_definitions.loss_vol_125pct: multiply negative portfolio daily and intraday PnL by 1.25; positive PnL unchanged
